title: SOUTHCOM: tic tac detected by space asset near a naval vessel

tellings.quote: Southcom southern command tic tac detected by space asset in proximity of vessel.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads from what he calls the Immaculate Constellation report, a document tied to a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown. According to the entry he reads, in the area of Southern Command, the US military command covering the seas and lands south of the United States, a Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, was detected by a sensor in space near a naval ship. If true, it would mean the military tracks such objects from orbit and keeps records of them.
